title: RussianSuperGLUE: A Russian Language Understanding Evaluation Benchmark
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for general Russian language understanding. The tasks focus on linguistic capabilities, reasoning, and common sense. While the 'Related Work' section mentions that other benchmarks might address 'ethical biases', the benchmark presented in this paper, RussianSuperGLUE, does not include any tasks or evaluations related to ethics, morals, or religion.
